name: Iijima Yun
source: A character designer who is responsible for the monster designs. She speaks in kansai-ben and has a firm personality, and often brings tea and tea sets into the company. Due to her mature personality, she gives off the aura of being older than she actually is. Yun also dresses often in gothic fashion.
